kind: proposed implementation contract, not a deployed API
rules: local persist does not mutate a business record
saved requires acknowledged revision >= displayed saved revision
older acknowledged revision does not mark newer input saved
same unresolved intent retains key and exact reviewed payload
confirmed core result survives later phase failure
phase progress cannot be reset by back navigation or a different tab
an unfinalized attachment is not Ready
scope IDs remain present in persisted edit proposals
a retired draft cannot be resurrected by a stale writer
actual server lifecycle stays draft/active/on_hold/completed/archived; these UI states are separate

logical_transition_examples.retain: dirty proposal and last acknowledged revision
original key, payload, hash, expected version

logical_transition_examples.effect: store existing result; do not recreate

privacy_identity_exception: Existing verified Auth UUID and exact role at the identity seam only; not arbitrary event record identifiers.
proposed_context_note: New properties need registry/allowlist/privacy approval. No exact workflow-run key or fingerprinting.
